title: Carry a caller reading position between Cosmos instances
goal: Propagate owner-scoped Cosmos session tokens when a later request uses an independent client and must observe recent writes.

selectionNotes: Propagate owner-scoped Cosmos session tokens when a later request uses an independent client and must observe recent writes.

Actual owner-scoped response tokens cross independent clients and the owner partition reads the recent write. Another owner has no stored token. Local execution does not prove cloud replica lag or consistency enforcement.

packageAssets: EF Cosmos11 lib/net11.0; EF Cosmos10 lib/net10.0. Both consumers select Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos3.63.1 lib/netstandard2.0 (Client, Core, Direct and Serialization.HybridRow) and Newtonsoft.Json13.0.4 lib/net6.0. Full transitive and native assets are pinned by each package lock.
providers: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Cosmos11.0.0 and Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos3.63.1 against the approved legacy Linux NoSQL emulator2.14.28.0, loopback HTTPS gateway and a uniquely marked playbook_ database. No cloud/account parity.
platforms: Windows x64 actual execution; other platforms unverified

constraints: Actual owner-scoped response tokens cross independent clients and the owner partition reads the recent write. Another owner has no stored token. Local execution does not prove cloud replica lag or consistency enforcement.
Cosmos NoSQL; preserve document ID and complete partition keys. Caller-bound token ownership is not authorization. No cloud, performance or GA claim.
Previous samples add no .NET10 foundation or target10 edition.
prerequisites: Copy complete projects and restore exact pins.
Run eng/Test-ReefDocuments.ps1 -Record with the approved isolated local emulator.
stabilityLimitations: Stable API contract prepared using .NET11 GA SDK/runtime and EF11 RC2 packages; no experimental opt-in. Actual GA reconciliation remains outstanding.
